test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 03 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is Option (1) i.e. '**baffled**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The context surrounding the blank suggests a strong, positive reaction to the discovery of the Lascaux cave complex, which contrasts with the otherwise mundane reaction to such discoveries in present times.
 
• '**Baffled**' indicates a state of being perplexed or bewildered, which is a plausible reaction upon encountering the unexpected and extraordinary prehistoric art of the Lascaux caves.**(भ्रमित या हतप्रभ होने की अवस्था या भाव)**

Therefore, the correct answer is '**baffled**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **'Overthrown' (परास्त)** refers to being removed from power, which does not fit the context of a reaction to an archaeological discovery.
 
• **'Encouraged' (प्रोत्साहित)** implies being given support, confidence, or hope, which, although positive, doesn’t specifically capture the likely astonishment caused by the discovery of the cave paintings.
 
• **'Crushed' ('कुचल दिया')** indicates being defeated or overwhelmed, typically in an emotional or physical sense, which does not convey the appropriate response to the discovery.

 

**Complete Passage is:** When another old cave is discovered in the south of France, it is not (1) ***usually ***in news. Rather, it is an ordinary event. Such discoveries are so (2) ***frequent ***these days that hardly anybody pays heed to them. However, when the Lascaux cave complex was discovered in 1940, the world was (3) ***baffled***__. Painted directly on its walls were hundreds of scenes showing how people lived thousands of years ago. The scenes show people hunting animals, such as bison or wild cats. Other images (4)________ birds and, most noticeably, horses, which appear in more than 300 wall images, by far (5)________ all other animals.

21b:Te2e,

The correct answer is Option (2) i.e. '**depict**'
